title: My speaking answers
standfirst: The five questions and the five answers, learned until they come out without thinking.
summary: Each answer is a full sentence with something extra in it, because that is what scores two.

answers.a: Je m'appelle Sam. Ma sœur s'appelle Lily. Et toi ?
answers.en: My name is Sam. My sister is called Lily. And you?

answers.a: Ça va très bien, merci. Et toi ?
answers.en: I'm very well, thank you. And you?

answers.q: Tu habites où ? Dans quel pays ?
answers.a: J'habite à Bridgend, au Pays de Galles.
answers.en: I live in Bridgend, in Wales.

answers.a: Dans le futur, je voudrais habiter en Italie parce qu'il fait chaud.
answers.en: In the future I'd like to live in Italy because it's hot.

answers.a: J'ai douze ans. Mon anniversaire, c'est le quinze mars.

rules.lead: What turns one mark into two
rules.body: A full sentence rather than a word. A connective — et, parce que. Something about somebody else. A question back: Et toi ? And the sounds said right.

notes.lead: These exact words, and no others
notes.body: The test is answering from memory, so the five answers below are the five to learn. Two different ways of answering the same question is harder to hold than one, and under pressure the two get mixed. Pick these and stay with them.
